subject: Dedicated capacity options and $/1M token sensitivity — Aurora Health follow-up
messages:
From: Ava Glover <ava.glover@aurorahealth.com>
To: irene_choi@redwood.ai
Cc: 
Date: 2027-06-21T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up: dedicated capacity pricing ask

Hi Irene,

Thanks for the call earlier — that was helpful. As requested, summarizing Aurora's rough usage profile so you can map to dedicated lanes and provide a $/1M token sensitivity: 

- Models: mostly distilled gpt-family variants (production is gpt-open-3B / gpt-open-7B), some finetuned customer-intent models.
- Avg sequence length: ~512 tokens (we trim long contexts, but some documents go longer).
- Monthly token volume: currently 120M tokens, target growth to 250–300M tokens within 3–6 months if latency/costs look good.
- Peak concurrency: bursts to ~40 concurrent sessions, sustained ~8–12.
- SLA: low-latency for chat paths (tail p95 under 600ms).
- Procurement budget: preliminary target $18k–$45k / month for inference, but flexible if unit $/1M tokens aligns.

Can you send a short matrix showing: 1) GPU types (A100/H100), 2) reserved GPU counts (2 / 4 / 8 / 16 lanes), 3) expected sustained throughput (tokens/sec), and 4) ballpark $/1M token for each scenario? Also include pilot pricing for a 2-week smoke test (2 GPUs).

CC'ing Derek (procurement) after this. Looking for pricing and next steps to present to finance by next Friday.

Thanks,
Ava
Ava Glover
Head of Platform Integrations
Aurora Health

From: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Glover <ava.glover@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-21T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: dedicated capacity pricing ask

Hi Ava — thanks for the clear summary. Attaching a compact pricing matrix and the dedicated terms PDF (see attachments). Below is a concise option set and the assumptions we used so you can see how the $/1M token was derived.

Assumptions: average seq 512 tokens, latency SLO p95 target 600ms, model family performance estimated on gpt-open-7B profile. We assumed a mix of streaming and non-streaming calls (50/50).

Option matrix (ballparks, per-month):
- Pilot: 2x A100 (reserved 2 GPUs) — sustained ~12k tokens/sec across the pool, expected monthly throughput ~150M tokens; price: $6,000/mo (pilot promo) -> ~ $40 / 1M tokens (pilot-adjusted).
- Small reserve: 4x A100 — sustained ~28k tokens/sec, monthly throughput ~360M tokens; price: $16,000/mo -> ~ $44 / 1M tokens.
- Medium reserve: 8x A100 — sustained ~60k tokens/sec, monthly throughput ~780M tokens; price: $28,500/mo -> ~ $36 / 1M tokens.
- Large reserve: 8x H100 — higher perf variant: sustained ~95k tokens/sec; price: $45,000/mo -> ~ $25 / 1M tokens at higher scale (H100 carries different amortized cost).
- Enterprise: 16x H100 — sustained ~180k tokens/sec, price: custom (tbd) -> <$20 / 1M tokens (volume-dependent).

Notes:
- The $/1M token numbers are approximate and sensitive to sequence length and ratio of streaming to non-streaming. Shorter seqs materially reduce cost per 1M.
- We recommend a 2-week pilot on 2x A100 to validate tail latency and cold-start behavior; we can provide a temporary discounted pilot rate (see pilot row / attachment).
- If Aurora expects rapid scale to 250–300M/mo in 3 months, the 4x A100 lane is the most straightforward near-term fit; H100 options reduce unit cost but require longer lead time for reserved hardware procurement and higher minimum commitments.

Attachments: Aurora_pricing_breakdown.xlsx (breaks down per-token math), redwood-dedicated-terms.pdf

Next steps we propose:
1) Confirm model family and whether heavy KV cache (long lived sessions) is required — changes batching efficiency.
2) Confirm target pilot start window (you mentioned "as soon as next week" on the call).
3) Procurement contact / PO timeline from Derek so we can route a formal pilot quote/PO.

Ben/Marissa — can you please: 1) schedule a quick 45m bench to surface A100 perf for gpt-open-3B at 512 tokens, and 2) prepare the pilot quote doc for a 2-week trial.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Sales Director, Dedicated
Redwood Inference

From: Ava Glover <ava.glover@aurorahealth.com>

Irene — this is super helpful, thank you. A few clarifications from our side:

- Monthly tokens: baseline 120M today, very likely 200–250M within 2 months, 300M+ if pilot succeeds and we ramp.
- Sequence mix: 65% ~512 tokens, 25% short queries (~64 tokens), 10% long form (1k+).
- Streaming %: approx 70% streaming for chat flows.
- Peak concurrency: 40 sessions but many are short-lived; sustained concurrency expectation 10–15.

Procurement: Derek here — we can sign pilot PO quickly. Target: pilot start 2027-06-28 (next Monday). For the full reserve, finance wants to see a 3-month projection with $/1M sensitivity at 120M / 200M / 300M.

Please send the pilot quote + the 3-month sensitivity table by end of day Friday so we can route to finance. Also include any minimum SLA credit protections in the attached terms.

Thanks,
Ava
Derek Malone
Senior Procurement Manager
Aurora Health
